message.content: {"evidence":"Original N/E/U curves show a sustained elevated platform from ~day 473 to ~day 520 (e.g., E shifts from ~−2 mm to ~+6 mm and holds, U from ~10 mm to ~25 mm and holds), then a sharp drop at day 520 back toward the pre-473 trend; residuals confirm a step-up at 473 and step-down at 520 with no intervening trend change—consistent with temporary offset and return.","pair_ids":["R1"]}
